segments.name: Reborn Coffee
segments.description: Wholesale and retail sales of coffee, water and other beverages through Reborn Coffee stores.
segments.evidence: Management has identified two reportable operating segments: (i) Reborn Coffee, which includes both wholesale and retail sales of coffee, water, and other beverages, and (ii) Reborn Logistics, which provides freight forwarding services.

segments.name: Reborn Logistics
segments.description: Freight forwarding and logistics services that move customers' goods from origin to destination.
segments.evidence: Management has identified two reportable operating segments: (i) Reborn Coffee, which includes both wholesale and retail sales of coffee, water, and other beverages, and (ii) Reborn Logistics, which provides freight forwarding services.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay for coffee and other beverages bought at retail stores or wholesale, and for freight forwarding services.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company's net revenue primarily consists of revenues from its retail stores and wholesale and online store.
